why: An improved constant bound on the conjecture's own quantity was posted Dec 2024 (0.715538 factor, first improvement in over two decades), plus a claimed full proof (Jan 2025, arXiv 2501.00614) and progress on the minimum-out-degree case (arXiv 2606.30588, out-degree 7), all directly about this problem as stated.
